test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a substitute for the given group of words.**

Hair of animals, which is soft and used for making wool.
solution:
The correct answer is 'fur'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us look into the **meaning** of the words in the options - 

 
 
• Bristles - a short, stiff hair on an animal's skin or a man's face.
 
• Kenosis - the renunciation of the divine nature.
 
• Fur - the short, fine, soft hair of certain animals.
 
• Grizzly hair - grey or grey-haired.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that fur is the best word to substitute for the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
